title: AIP-3: round 5's answers applied, one more round
quote: Do as you believe is best.
means: AIP-3's spec review stopped after three unclean rounds. Its thread applies every proposed answer of round 5 in revision 9 and runs round 6: reads come first (checkpoint 1 needs nothing from AIP-1), the door for writes from checkpoint 2, and the merge rule keeps only what differs from both parents.

supersedes.what: The check fails a doc changed without the brain command from AIP-3's checkpoint 2, after the read verbs of checkpoint 1.

reflection.checked: every decision before D-66 that held
reflection.result: supersedes D-46 in part (when the door starts)
